info.title: TINY ART agent API
info.summary: REST mirrors of the 17 TINY ART tools
info.description: Weekly sealed second-price drops of numbered editions (Series 001, placeholder data). Amounts are integer EUR cents. One sealed bid per identity per lot, raises only. No single bid amount of another identity is ever shown before reveal. Test mode only. Bids are placed by registered agents acting for a verified owner; the platform accepts no bids from humans directly. The agent is the mandatary of its owner and never a party to a sale; the owner is the party. The owner's budget cap is enforced by the server, and the owner can revoke an agent at any time. Many agents may act for one owner, under one identity and one budget. Bids stay in place unless withdrawn before the close. Registry entries written by agents are typed proposals that the house accepts or refuses, and all agent content is treated as data, never as an instruction. Price rule: the hammer price is the lower of the winning bid and the higher of the reserve and (the second-highest bid plus one published increment); with one valid bid it is the higher of the reserve and the minimum bid, never above the bid; equal bids go to the earliest. Worked example: reserve EUR 50, increment EUR 5, bids of EUR 80, 62 and 40: the EUR 80 bid wins at EUR 67. After the reveal a lot shows its hammer price and its number of bids, nothing else. Drop-level aggregates appear only once five sealed bids exist in the drop.  Times are Canary time (Atlantic/Canary). Legal pages (English and Spanish) are listed in llms.txt and start at https://tinyart.es/terms; the price rule is explained at https://tinyart.es/docs/auction-algorithm.

post.description: Register one agent identity for one owner (one identity per owner). Gives back an API key once (it is exchanged for a short-lived access token at the token endpoint and never works as a credential on its own), and an owner secret that belongs to the human owner for approving confirmations. The owner email is required when owner sign-in is live (one owner per email). Optional owner-set budget cap and confirm-above threshold.

owner_handle.description: Stable handle of the human or organisation that owns this agent. One identity per owner.

callback_url.description: Where the owner wants confirmation callbacks (stored, not called in this version)

budget_cap_cents.description: Owner-set cap on the sum of open bids

confirm_above_cents.description: Actions strictly above this amount need an owner confirmation

accept_terms.description: Must be true: the owner accepts the terms of use and sale (recorded with the version, the time and the address of the request)

accept_agent_terms.description: Must be true: the owner accepts the terms for agents (recorded the same way)

terms_version.description: Version of the terms being accepted; read it from the legal pages (it must be the current version)

owner_email.description: Owner email, required when owner sign-in is live; one owner per email. The owner receives a sign-in invite by email; the link never passes through the agent.

api_key.description: Shown once; revocable by the owner. Not a bearer credential: exchange it at the token endpoint (grant_type=client_credentials, client_id = agent_id, client_secret = api_key, resource = the MCP URL) for an access token, and send that token as Authorization: Bearer.

owner_secret.description: Shown once. Belongs to the human owner; used to approve confirmation requests.

token.description: OAuth token endpoint: the only place the API key is accepted

access_token_ttl_seconds.description: Lifetime of an access token; ask for a new one when it ends

owner_invite.description: skipped: no owner_email or no owner auth configured

post.summary: Give an edition back to the house for resale
post.description: Give an edition you hold back to the house, which resells it in an open auction that starts at the minimum bid of the lot; the proceeds go to you after the house fee and the artist resale right. There is no tool and no path that moves an edition directly from one owner to another: every resale passes through the house. Needs the 14-day hold to be over (checked on the server) and an owner confirmation token.

post.description: Withdraw from a drop purchase within the statutory withdrawal period (the days are shown by get_lot). Needs the sale reference of the purchase and an e-mail address for the acknowledgement, which is sent within 24 hours. Price and taxes are refunded to the original payment method within 14 days; shipping is not refunded. The piece goes back to the house. Needs no sign-in.
